task.title: Bound supervisor task-state lock latency and projection truth

handoffs.message: PR #4239 merged into dev as 1434effdc. Root cause was replay cost under the canonical lock, not lock bypass: every authoritative read replayed the whole journal and validate_event re-serializes each event's full state twice, so a status command paid four full passes and sync_task_state_shadow paid four per cycle while holding the exclusive lock. task_state_store now has load_snapshot (one lock window, one validated pass, validated-prefix checkpoint bound by SHA-256 over the exact bytes, mmap-ed read) and pure verify_snapshot; append_state_commit reads back its own bytes at their offset instead of replaying. sync_task_state_shadow reads once, and caught_up now means parity after reconciliation (verified by re-reading the board it wrote) with a separate repaired flag. verify_task_state_store samples board and journal in one lock domain, closing the transient event_count 2046 vs digest 2045 race. Provider gh probes moved outside the runtime-admission lock and every cycle now publishes its exclusive-hold duration. Measured on a 2050-event/159.5MB fixture: reviewer-approve-shaped commands under an active cycle 71.3s p95 legacy to 1.153s p95, under the 2s target, no config edit or worker kill. 791 tests pass. Review focus: acceptance item 1 is PARTIAL and recorded as such - sync_github_bus still runs gh network subprocesses inside the hold and confirm_kill still polls with bounded sleeps; both need a fetch/apply split I did not attempt. Also please scrutinise the checkpoint trust argument in evidence.json integrity_rules. Evidence: docs/deployment/evidence/supervisor/SUP-TASK-STATE-LOCK-LATENCY-001/evidence.json

Reviewer rejected after independent diff/evidence/test audit. Required corrections: (1) AC1 is unmet exactly as the manifest admits: _run_with_deferred_dispatch_status_syncs holds runtime_state_lock exclusively across _run_once_locked, which still calls sync_github_bus network/gh work and poll_workers/process_queue paths that can call terminate_worker_pid -> confirm_kill bounded sleeps. Move fetch/network/poll waits outside the exclusive lock; a partial acceptance cannot pass the task's absolute criterion. (2) The checkpoint is forgeable by a checkpoint-only write: _resume_point hashes the claimed journal prefix and self-validates checkpoint.last_event but never proves that last_event is the actual final line of that prefix. Isolated repro left journal bytes unchanged yet normal load_snapshot returned FORGED/done while forced full replay returned REAL/review. Bind the cached head/event_count/state to the actual prefix tail and add a negative regression for a forged but internally valid checkpoint. Update the integrity evidence. (3) AC3 is not proven: task_state_lock_latency_bench.py does not run governed approve/assign/note/reviewer commands or a full run_once cycle/runtime-admission hold; it simulates load plus a commit with append withheld against reconciliation-only task-lock contention. Add a full command/full active-cycle 2050-event fixture showing p95 <2s. Existing focused suites pass (86 tests); PR #4239 is merged at 1434effdc88fb79abd0125351a5206af8fe4a7c7 with green checks, but that does not close these acceptance gaps.

AC1 is still false: _run_once_locked invokes maybe_auto_commit_archive under the exclusive runtime-admission lock; that waits up to 180s while auto_commit_archive.py performs git fetch and task_finalize push/PR network work. The same locked cycle invokes reconcile_ownerless_in_progress_tasks, whose squash path calls _merged_pull_requests_for_branch -> run_gh_process with a 20s network timeout. Move archive and merged-PR lookup network work to prelock snapshots or deferred postlock execution with freshness/fail-closed apply gates, and add regressions proving those subprocesses run only outside runtime_state_lock. Deferred termination must also fail closed when worker_pid_start_ticks is unavailable and must not report termination complete before post-lock confirmation; current expected_start_ticks=None treats any reused PID as alive and can escalate against it. AC3 evidence is not end-to-end: task_state_lock_latency_bench.py runs synthetic _reconcile_once/current_load_state/current_commit with append withheld, never actual governed approve/assign/note/reviewer commands or the full run_once runtime-admission path. Add scratch-root concurrent governed-command coverage against a real/full supervisor cycle and refresh evidence. Independent focused validation: 108 relevant tests passed; bash helper syntax and git diff --check passed, but those suites do not cover these defects.
